question: Can deterministic checks plus Cloudflare-hosted GPT-OSS-120B identify every material claim in a supplied summary, assess those claims and material implications against the complete source, provide accurate source-bound correction guidance, and make the right decision after one Gemma correction?

architecture.authoritative_decision: strict local validation plus code-derived ACCEPT/REVISE/HOLD

sequence: 9 separately scored focused diagnostic checker calls using six reused development examples and three explicitly synthetic fixtures
focused diagnostic gate before the unchanged formal development set
condition-blinded semantic coverage assessment of development responses
one D14 Gemma correction and complete GPT-OSS recheck on a separately gated UTC day
12 hidden evaluation checker calls on a third separately gated UTC day
up to 3 eligible evaluation Gemma corrections
complete GPT-OSS recheck of each correction
boundaries: The checker receives no protected claim inventory and must identify material claims itself; protected meaning units are used only for post-response scoring.
Ordinary code validates structure and calculates adjudicated denominators but cannot prove semantic claim completeness or factual truth.
Claim-coverage mapping is CODEX_ASSISTED unless an actual human reviewer is separately recorded.
Every returned proposition portion is adjudicated as MAPPED, INVENTED, INVENTORY_GAP or UNCERTAIN_MAPPING after the response is frozen.
Inventory gaps and uncertain mappings remain separate from the checker decision and block the affected experimental gate until resolved under the frozen procedure.
A mapped portion cannot conceal an invented, inventory-gap or uncertain portion of a compound returned claim.
A citation is not proof that its passage supports the checker finding.
A different model family is not independent human verification.
A PASS would justify only a larger fresh-source validation.
No production adoption, automatic publication or deployment is authorised.
